question: As of December 2020, which of the following languages does NOT figure in the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhojpuri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• As of December 2020,** the Bhojpuri **language does not schedule in the **eighth schedule of the Indian Constitution.**
